name: Apache CouchDB
line: Self-hosted JSON document database with HTTP APIs and replication.

free.text: Free Apache-licensed software; hosting costs extra

cells.metered: No hosted price; you pay for infrastructure

sql.math: No hosting provider or setup is chosen yet. Hosting, disk space, backups and transfer decide the total.
Even with no requests, hosting, stored data and backup costs remain. The host and its rates are not stated.

files.math: Files can be stored as attachments, but the rates for hosting, copies, disk, backups and transfer are not stated.

jobs.math: Database software does not execute general background jobs
